change.description: A file of a gist to put or delete: exactly one of content or delete.

content.description: Its text from now, written as UTF-8.

name.description: Its name at the gist's root, with no /.

main.description: Puts and deletes files of a gist in one commit to its default branch, "Edit gist", then sets its description, if given, as `knotless gist edit` does. Only the gist's owner may, logged in to this appview's web pages: requires the session cookie the pages' login sets, and the appview writes with the session it keeps for that account.

errors.description: No change, a file with no name or a name with a /, a file given both content and delete, or neither, or a name changed twice.
errors.name: InvalidRequest

errors.description: No such repository, or it is not a gist.
errors.name: NotFound

errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.
errors.name: AuthenticationRequired

errors.description: The account logged in is not the gist's owner.
errors.name: Forbidden

description.description: What the gist says it is from now: an empty string drops it, and it stays as it is when absent.

files.description: The files to put or delete, each named once. A rename is a delete of the old name and a put of the new.

changed.description: False when the files are as they were, and nothing was pushed.

description.description: What the gist says it is now.

sha.description: The commit made, when files were put or deleted.

description: Changes a gist of the account logged in to this appview's pages.
